behavior: Reads stripe_webhook_events by event_id and returns duplicate when processed=true.
Upserts the Stripe event into stripe_webhook_events with processed=false.
Processes checkout.session.completed inline in the same HTTP handler.
Creates/updates revenue order, event ledger, entitlement, fulfillment request and economic event records.
Marks stripe_webhook_events processed=true only at the end of the inline path.

Therefore the requested claim that stripe_webhook_events is the sole existing inbox is not true in the current repository.

flow: claimTask() calls RPC claim_economic_model_task with p_model_name, p_model_role and p_lease_seconds.
The worker then calls LLM_API_URL/BEC_CLOUD_LM_URL with LLM_API_KEY/BEC_CLOUD_LM_API_KEY and LLM_MODEL/BEC_CLOUD_LM_MODEL.
It records an assessment through record_economic_assessment.
It PATCHes economic_model_tasks to completed or failed.
6_economic_model_task_trace.important_finding: The inspected 20260908_economic_task_and_prediction_guardrails_v1.sql defines an earlier claim_economic_model_task signature taking p_task_id and p_lease_seconds, not the model-name/model-role signature used by the current worker. This indicates a schema/function-version boundary that must be resolved against live Supabase before execution can be trusted.
6_economic_model_task_trace.lm_studio_finding: The worker does not directly reference a Windows LM Studio port. It depends on the configured LLM_API_URL/BEC_CLOUD_LM_URL. Therefore local LM Studio availability is not established by this source. The exact runtime failure point cannot be proven without live function/database/runtime evidence.
